Zimmermann PWA Kit, SFCC-236 product card. This is a postbuild rework step: `zimmerMANNPostBuild`'s Round 10 sweep found 2 confirmed UNIFORM findings, and the developer said "go build" on both. Two independent fixes, both low-risk, one comment-only and one a real (but purely mechanical) code extraction.

## Fix A — stale `:focus-within` documentation in ZimmProductCardMedia's file family (comment/prose only, zero functional change)

Context: commit `983bddf` (earlier this session) migrated the organism's own carousel-arrow reveal from `:focus-within` to `:has(:focus-visible)` (fixing a real bug: clicking an arrow gave it real DOM focus, keeping `:focus-within` true after the mouse left, so arrows stuck visible). That fix was correctly scoped to only 3 files inside `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/` (`zimmProductCard.css.ts`, `index.test.tsx`, `index.tsx`) — Media's own code was never touched functionally (it never had any reveal logic of its own to begin with; the reveal has always lived entirely on the organism's recipe). But Media's own docblocks *describe* the organism's mechanism by name in several places, and those descriptions are now stale — they still say `:focus-within` where the organism now uses `:has(:focus-visible)`. Fix: update every one of these 4 spots to say `:has(:focus-visible)` instead of `:focus-within`. Do not change any actual code/CSS logic in these 4 files — they have none to change; this is purely correcting stale prose.

1. **`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.tsx`** (around line 110, inside the module docblock) — find:
```
 * the indicator is fully gated by this recipe's own media query. The arrows are not — this
 * recipe only ever sets them to `display: none`; the actual reveal (`display: flex`, on
 * `&:hover`/`&:focus-within`) lives in the composing `ZimmProductCard` organism's own recipe,
```
replace the one occurrence of `&:focus-within` in that sentence with `&:has(:focus-visible)`, giving:
```
 * the indicator is fully gated by this recipe's own media query. The arrows are not — this
 * recipe only ever sets them to `display: none`; the actual reveal (`display: flex`, on
 * `&:hover`/`&:has(:focus-visible)`) lives in the composing `ZimmProductCard` organism's own recipe,
```

2. **`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts`** (around line 186, inside the `carousel` part's comment) — find the sentence containing `scoped to \`:hover\`/\`:focus-within\` on the whole card` (read the file first to get the exact surrounding text verbatim, since the precise wording matters and this is a single continuous comment block above the `carousel` key) and change `:focus-within` to `:has(:focus-visible)` in that one sentence, leaving everything else in the comment untouched.

3. **`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.stories.tsx`** — two spots in the `MultipleImages` story's docblock/comments:
   - Find: `the desktop prev/next arrows' hover/focus-within reveal now lives entirely on that` → change `hover/focus-within` to `hover/has(:focus-visible)`.
   - Find (in the "No `play`" comment below the story object): `their only reveal rule lives on ZimmProductCard's own organism root recipe` followed by `` (`&:hover`/`&:focus-within` scoped to that root) `` → change `` `&:focus-within` `` to `` `&:has(:focus-visible)` ``.

4. **`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.test.tsx`** (around line 300-302, in the "real recipe assertions" describe block's own docblock comment, directly above the test titled `'carousel (arrows) has no reveal of its own at this recipe level...'`) — find:
```
   * removed from `carousel` entirely — the real hover/focus-within reveal now lives one layer up,
   * on `ZimmProductCard`'s own organism recipe (`zimmProductCard.css.ts` docblock point 6),
   * scoped to the whole card via `&:hover`/`&:focus-within`, which this Media-only recipe has no
```
change both occurrences (`hover/focus-within` → `hover/has(:focus-visible)`, and `` `&:focus-within` `` → `` `&:has(:focus-visible)` ``) in that comment.

After Fix A: run `npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/` and confirm all tests still pass (they must — no code changed, only comments).

## Fix B — extract the duplicated `DESKTOP_QUERY` viewport gate into `zimmProductCardShared.ts`

Context: `HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY` already lives once in `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/zimmProductCardShared.ts` and is imported by both `zimmProductCard.css.ts` and `zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts`, specifically so the two files "can't silently drift" on that media feature. The exact same reasoning was never applied to `DESKTOP_QUERY`, a `min-width` viewport gate needed by both `zimmProductCard.css.ts` (the PLP bag-icon mobile hide) and `zimmProductCardContent.css.ts` (the responsive outer padding) — today each file independently derives it from `breakpoints.md`. Not a live bug (both copies agree today), but the same DRY/drift risk the `HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY` extraction exists to prevent. Extract it the same way.

### 1. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/zimmProductCardShared.ts`

Current full file:
```ts
/**
 * Shared DOM-contract constants for the ZimmProductCard organism and its composed molecules
 * (ZimmProductCardMedia, ZimmProductCardContent) — defined once here so every producer (the JSX
 * that stamps a `data-card-slot` attribute) and consumer (the organism's own recipe selectors,
 * plus this component family's test suites) reads the same value instead of each independently
 * retyping it. Same pattern, smaller scale, as `zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts`.
 */

/**
 * The ten `data-card-slot` attribute values that wire the organism's hover/reveal CSS
 * (`zimmProductCard.css.ts`) to specific descendant DOM nodes. `media` / `badge` / `close` /
 * `carousel` / `indicator` are stamped by `ZimmProductCardMedia`; `content` / `bag` / `price` /
 * `sizeChips` / `notifyMe` by `ZimmProductCardContent`. Do not rename a value here without
 * checking both molecules' own docblocks, which document what each slot is for.
 */
export const CARD_SLOT = {
  media: 'media',
  badge: 'badge',
  close: 'close',
  carousel: 'carousel',
  indicator: 'indicator',
  content: 'content',
  bag: 'bag',
  price: 'price',
  sizeChips: 'sizeChips',
  notifyMe: 'notifyMe',
} as const;

/**
 * Hover-capable-pointer gate shared by every hover-only affordance across the card family
 * (desktop arrows, the hover-reveal price/size-selector swap, the notify-me reveal) — the
 * resolved SFCC-236 decision that arrows and the touch slide-indicator are mutually exclusive by
 * pointer capability, not viewport width.
 */
export const HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY = '@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)';
```

Change to:
```ts

/**
 * Shared DOM-contract constants for the ZimmProductCard organism and its composed molecules
 * (ZimmProductCardMedia, ZimmProductCardContent) — defined once here so every producer (the JSX

 * plus this component family's test suites) reads the same value instead of each independently
 * retyping it. Same pattern, smaller scale, as `zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts`.
 */

/**

 * `carousel` / `indicator` are stamped by `ZimmProductCardMedia`; `content` / `bag` / `price` /
 * `sizeChips` / `notifyMe` by `ZimmProductCardContent`. Do not rename a value here without
 * checking both molecules' own docblocks, which document what each slot is for.
 */
export const CARD_SLOT = {
  media: 'media',
  badge: 'badge',
  close: 'close',
  carousel: 'carousel',
  indicator: 'indicator',
  content: 'content',
  bag: 'bag',
  price: 'price',
  sizeChips: 'sizeChips',
  notifyMe: 'notifyMe',
} as const;

/**
 * Hover-capable-pointer gate shared by every hover-only affordance across the card family
 * (desktop arrows, the hover-reveal price/size-selector swap, the notify-me reveal) — the
 * resolved SFCC-236 decision that arrows and the touch slide-indicator are mutually exclusive by
 * pointer capability, not viewport width.
 */
export const HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY = '@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)';

/**
 * Desktop viewport-width gate shared by the two places with a real min-width-driven layout
 * change: the organism's own PLP bag-icon mobile hide (`zimmProductCard.css.ts`) and
 * `ZimmProductCardContent`'s responsive outer padding (`zimmProductCardContent.css.ts`).
 * Extracted for the identical reason `HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY` above was — each file previously
 * derived this independently from the same `breakpoints.md` token, which is exactly the
 * same-value-typed-twice drift risk a shared constant removes.
 */
export const DESKTOP_QUERY = `@media (min-width: ${breakpoints.md})`;
```

Read the real current file first to confirm it matches what's quoted above before editing — if it doesn't match exactly, stop and report the discrepancy rather than guessing.

### 2. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/zimmProductCard.css.ts`

Leave the rest of that paragraph/docblock untouched.

/**

 * (ZimmProductCardMedia, ZimmProductCardContent) — defined once here so every producer (the JSX

 * plus this component family's test suites) reads the same value instead of each independently
 * retyping it. Same pattern, smaller scale, as `zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts`.
 */

/**
 * The ten `data-card-slot` attribute values that wire the organism's hover/reveal CSS
 * (`zimmProductCard.css.ts`) to specific descendant DOM nodes. `media` / `badge` / `close` /
 * `carousel` / `indicator` are stamped by `ZimmProductCardMedia`; `content` / `bag` / `price` /
 * `sizeChips` / `notifyMe` by `ZimmProductCardContent`. Do not rename a value here without
 * checking both molecules' own docblocks, which document what each slot is for.
 */
export const CARD_SLOT = {
  media: 'media',
  badge: 'badge',
  close: 'close',
  carousel: 'carousel',
  indicator: 'indicator',
  content: 'content',
  bag: 'bag',
  price: 'price',
  sizeChips: 'sizeChips',
  notifyMe: 'notifyMe',
} as const;

/**
 * Hover-capable-pointer gate shared by every hover-only affordance across the card family
 * (desktop arrows, the hover-reveal price/size-selector swap, the notify-me reveal) — the
 * resolved SFCC-236 decision that arrows and the touch slide-indicator are mutually exclusive by
 * pointer capability, not viewport width.
 */
export const HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY = '@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)';

107	 *      superseded by Fix H — see point 6) — `:hover` alone would leave every reveal permanently

132	 *          whatever it shows is the only state a touch pointer ever sees) shows it plainly with no
133	 *          reveal needed. Putting the "hidden by default" half outside the media query — matching

166	 *      `[HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY]` block — a device-CAPABILITY check, not an actual-hover check —

419	          // `display: 'flex'` (it centres the icon inside via alignItems/justifyContent) — this

422	          // would win the cascade either way, so restoring the actual display type Content uses
423	          // matters here, not just "anything visible" — 'block' would silently flatten that
424	          // wrapper's centering.
425	          [`[data-card-slot="${CARD_SLOT.content}"] [data-card-slot="${CARD_SLOT.bag}"]`]: { display: 'flex' },
426	        }),
427	      },
428	    },
429	  }),

import type { SystemStyleObject } from '@chakra-ui/react';
import { breakpoints } from 'app/theme/foundation';
import { CARD_SLOT, HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY } from '../../zimmProductCardShared';

/**
 * Same hover-capable-pointer gate `zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts` already establishes for its own
 * arrows/indicator split — now a shared import from `zimmProductCardShared.ts` rather than each
 * file's own module-private copy, so the two can't silently drift. Governs the price <->
 * size-selector swap below, so both composed children's hover treatments engage together off the
 * exact same media feature, on this shared root.
 */

/**
 * A viewport-width gate, unrelated to `HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY` above — governs the PLP-only bag-icon

/**

  baseStyle: ({
    hoverHidesPrice,
    hoverRevealsPrice,
    hoverRevealsSizeSelector,
    hoverRevealsNotifyMe,
    sizeSelectorUnavailable,
    hideBagOnMobile,

    root: {
      position: 'relative',
      width: '100%',

        content: '""',
        position: 'absolute',
        inset: 0,

            display: 'block',
          },
          // Fix 2 / Fix H — see the hoverRevealsPrice block above for the full rationale.
          [`&:has(:focus-visible) [data-card-slot="${CARD_SLOT.content}"] [data-card-slot="${CARD_SLOT.notifyMe}"]`]: {
            display: 'block',
          },

        // 6. Carousel arrow reveal — see docblock point 6. Unconditional (no

        // `zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts`'s own `[HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY]: { display: 'flex' }` used to

          display: 'flex',
        },
        [`&:has(:focus-visible) [data-card-slot="${CARD_SLOT.carousel}"]`]: {
          display: 'flex',
        },
      },

        [`[data-card-slot="${CARD_SLOT.content}"] [data-card-slot="${CARD_SLOT.bag}"]`]: { display: 'none' },

      // `hideBagOnMobile` each their OWN separate `...(condition && { [DESKTOP_QUERY]: {...} })`
